extraction.policy_summary: Bharat Forge states it provides equal employment opportunities without discrimination on grounds including disability, via a standalone 'Equal Opportunity Policy for Persons with Disabilities' (BFL-22) document published on the company website, in response to the mandated BRSR question on an equal opportunity policy per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: 0 differently abled employees and 0 differently abled workers reported, out of 2,849 total employees and 7,774 total workers.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: The Company's facilities, including premises/offices, have been equipped with ramps, lifts, and handrails for stairwells to facilitate the movement of differently abled individuals, and premises are stated to be accessible to differently abled visitors.
extraction.compliance_details: In the mandated BRSR statutory questions, Bharat Forge states its premises/offices have been made accessible to differently abled employees and workers per the RPwD Act, 2016 (citing ramps, lifts, and handrails), that it has an equal opportunity policy per the RPwD Act, 2016 with a dedicated policy PDF web-link, and answers 'Yes' that its premises are accessible to differently abled visitors per the same Act.
